title: How many selected findings are true?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the prior share of true alternatives and test power.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the prior share of true alternatives and test power affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the prior share of true alternatives and test power in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
